offers_money_non_negative.name: offers_money_non_negative
offers_money_non_negative.value:
coalesce("offers"."original_price", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("offers"."offer_price", 0) >= 0
        and coalesce("offers"."flat_amount_off", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("offers"."min_purchase_amount", 0) >= 0
        and coalesce("offers"."max_discount_amount", 0) >= 0

offers_offer_price_below_original.name: offers_offer_price_below_original
offers_offer_price_below_original.value: "offers"."original_price" is null or "offers"."offer_price" is null or "offers"."offer_price" < "offers"."original_price"
